history_full:
Kum 1910-a Sihphir-a Kohhran a lo din khán Kohhran Hmeichhia hi a ding ve nghâl mai em tih chu chhui chhuah theih a ni tawh lo a. Mahse, hruaitu hlui vawiin thlenga la damte tawngkam atangin kum 1949 vêl kha chuan Sihphir Kohhran Hmeichhia hi a ding tawh ngei nia hriat a ni. Kohhran Hmeichhe inkhawmte pawh an nei thin a. A tül angin Committee pawh an thu khâwm thin bawk a. Tanpui ngai leh chhawmdawl ngaite pawh an tanpuiin an chhawmdawl thin a ni tih chu chiang takin an sawi thei a. An committee thurelte pawh ziakin an chhinchhiah thlip thlep rih lem lo pawh a ni mahna! Hmuh tur leh hriat tur engmah a awm tawh lo a ni. Tin, tute nge hruaitu ni a, tute nge committee-ah chuan tel thin tih pawh a hriat theih tak tak tawh lo a ni.

Tun hma deuh, hun eng emawti chhung chu Sihphir Kohhran hi Durtlang bialah a tel a. Chuvangin Durtlang bial Minute lamah kum 1947-1948 chhunga Sihphir Kohhran Hmeichhe hruaitute chu hmuh theihin a awm a. Mahse, heng hruaitute hian eng chanvo nge an chelh tih leh eng hun chhung atana hruaitute nge an nih pawh a hriat theih chuang loh. Chuta hming kan hmuh theih Sihphir Kohhran Hmeichhe hruaitu hmasate chu:

1. Pi Lalthanghuti, w/o Pu Zathuama (L)
2. Pi Zatangi, d/o Upa Kaichhunga (L)
3. Pi Chhungi, m/o Pu Zathianga (L)
4. Pi Thlengtuthangi, w/o Pu Zahnuna (L)
5. Pi Sekungi, w/o Khamngova (L)
6. Pi Lalringliani, m/o Zailiana
7. Pi Sapzuithangi, m/o Upa H. Lianmawia
8. Pi Zasuaki, w/o Pu Hmartawna
9. Pi Manthangi, m/o Pu Zaruala

Hun rei tak chhung chu Kohhran Hmeichhe inkhawm hi Pathianni Sande sikul banah inkhawm mai thin a ni a. Chiang taka kan hriat theih chin – kum 1980 atang kha chuan chawlhkar tin Zirtawpni zan apiangin an inkhawm thin a. Ram pum huapa mumal zâwk leh rualkhai zâwka kal tlàn theihna tur thlirin, Central Kohhran Hmeichhe Committee chuan kar tin Thawhlehni zan hi Kohhran Hmeichhe inkhawm zan atan a ruat ta a. He hun hi vawiin thlengin Kohhran Hmeichhe inkhawm hun atan hman a ni ta a ni.
